helper_extraction_review.evidence: The retained helper body after the injected docstring is AST-identical to the original prepare body after its audit/current assignments; operation kind, limits, request bytes, staging and no-op branches are unchanged.

checks.evidence: safe_path rejects aliases, dot segments, control DEL and non-NFC spellings before checked_path.
RetainedTree captures root/descendant identities and complete sets, performs a sibling stat prepass before payload reads, and verifies bytes, identities and ancestor descriptors on every exit.
validator_mirror uses a fresh nonce under one retained batch session, records owned directory/file identities, rejects collisions and verifies original tree plus mirror in finalization.
_verify_all preserves ContractError and normalizes OSError/StagingError while continuing verification; final safety errors replace ordinary active failures through the context-manager finally path.
Entry, depth, per-file and total-byte limits remain bounded through the two-pass capture.

finding.evidence: Captured-file and captured-ancestor replacement injected after assemble_conversion returned, on both normal and ordinary-prepare-failure paths, produced one retained _vault session but the boundary returned AUDIT_RACE / "Vault changed during integrity audit". Ordinary prepare failure without mutation preserved SOURCE_CONVERSION_INJECTED; success without mutation remained source_publication_prepared.
finding.impact: The requested conversion safety contract says safety uses WORK_PATH_UNSAFE and takes precedence over ordinary validation/staleness errors. If this applies to a named Vault lineage race, the candidate boundary classification is not compliant. The IO module itself remains GO.
